main_text.l: rectius instructam viciet. Sic enim sancti Pa-tres,& tum Christus ipse tum discipuli externo cultui diligenter interfuerunt, quanuis & tota doctrina in synagogis, & quaecunque in templo gerebantur, essent falsissimis interpretationibus contaminata. Hæc tamē etiam tunc adhibenda cautio est, vt infirmorum aliorum fratrum conscientiæ, quoad eius fieri poteft, caueatur, ficut nos idem Apostolus monet 1.ad Cor.10.29. & quidem de rebus indif-ferentibus agens.

Summa autem horum omnium hæc est, Quum sacra Domini Cœna, ex pactione Dei cum sua Ecclesia verbo Sacramentali testata, constet signis & rebus significatis, & hæc duo in mutua relatione consistant, vix dici posse Cœnam Dominicam edere (vt de Corinthiis loquitur Paulus) qui verbo Sacramentali non nisi peregrina lingua abutuntur, vt perinde faciant ac si semel esset expunctum: qui panem illum & vinum illud abolent transsub-stantiationis commento:qui denique ritibus Sacramentalibus sublatis, actionem hanc to-tam miserè mutilant.
CAPUT II. De rebus Sacramentaliter in sacra Domini Cœna significatis & sub fidei conditione præbitis.

page.notes: The tailpiece ornament between the text and the chapter heading is not transcribed (no text). The margin note is printed in bold italic, set in two lines ("Conclusio" / "superioris disputatio-" / "nis."), and is transcribed as one note. The long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "falsissimis", "poteft" was read as "potest", and "transsub-stantiationis" joins across the line-end hyphen. The running head is transcribed with its printed period. Doubtful: "tamē" (macron over e read as a abbreviation of tamen), and the spacing in "commento:qui", which is printed without a space. The heading's "CAPVT" has been normalised to "CAPUT" per the u/v rule.
